newsitem.title: GREECE: GERMAN ARRESTED IN GREECE WITH 50 KG OF HEROIN.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN ARRESTED IN GREECE WITH 50 KG OF HEROIN.

text.p: A German man was arrested on the Greek holiday island of Corfu with 50 kilos of pure heroin, police said on Tuesday.
They said Jansen Horter had the heroin, worth around $1.8 million, hidden inside a false fuel tank in his car. He will be charged with drug smuggling later in the day.
"He smuggled the heroin from Turkey and would sell it back in Germany. He was about to board a ship for Italy," a police official said.
